_about: Per-strand cost profile for the DNS-STARK sliver-proving simulator. Measure-once table: prove/verify times and peak RSS measured in isolation on one machine; the simulator (sim.py) composes these into a parallel wall-clock estimate for P processors WITHOUT running P processors. Regenerate/extend via scripts/bench-circuit-rss.sh (prove_ms/verify_ms/proof_bytes from the RESULT lines, rss_mib from /usr/bin/time -l).
measured_on: Apple M4, 16 GB, rayon = all cores (multi-core NODE granularity)
_note_granularity: These times use all Mac cores per strand, so one 'processor' in the sim models a multi-core NODE. For single-core nodes, re-profile with RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1.
_note_split: dblstrand/wdblfull prove_ms/verify_ms are split from the measured combined gate wall (one honest prove+verify; tamper paths are validate-only) at the measured 27/73 prove:verify ratio.

limbproduct_256.role: RSA limb strand, L=256 (W=512) — RSA-2048 sliver unit

modmul_8192_rsa2048.role: RSA-2048 MONOLITHIC ModMul<8192> (pre-sliver; split from 3119s combined)

keccakf_mldsa.role: ML-DSA Keccak-f / DNS commitment (peak-RSS ML-DSA circuit)

join_aggregation.role: Tier-A batched-Merkle join node (2-to-1 root aggregation)

merkle_path_d2.role: Tier-B M2b: depth-2 Merkle path (FRI query opening)

m5_kernel.role: Tier-B M5 kernel: FS challenge drives fold

comm_edge_bytes._note: Tier-A aggregation transfers 32-byte roots. Tier-B recursion transfers the inner PROOF (use the leaf's proof_bytes) — set --edge proof on the CLI for that variant.
